description: Documentation for readers and tooling; no script loads it. scripts/check-audio-provenance.mjs is the contract — it enforces every rule below plus the type checks, and its in-scope extensions are .wav .mp3 .ogg .m4a .flac .aac .opus .oga .aiff .aif .wma plus the audio-capable containers .webm .mp4 .m4v (containers are declared in full because the gate does not decode them).
title: web-ai-showcase site-wide audio provenance ledger

legacyBaseline.description: The frozen legacy declaration. Assets bundled at `sha` had no rights record when this gate was introduced; their content hashes are listed explicitly (never a filename pattern) and the legacy set can only shrink. The list is a CROSS-CHECK, not the source of truth: the gate re-derives the in-scope content hashes from `sha` with git ls-tree/cat-file and fails with BASELINE MISMATCH if `hashes` or the counts disagree, so appending a hash cannot make the gate pass. Declaring a content hash that is not in the derived set as legacy-unreconciled FAILS the gate.

archetype.description: licensed = third-party audio with a rights record; first-party = generated for this project; legacy-unreconciled = bundled before this gate, no rights record, frozen in legacyBaseline.hashes.

rightsCleared.description: Only the literal JSON boolean true marks an entry reconciled; the gate rejects any other type (a string "false" is truthy in JS) and treats the entry as unreconciled.

provenance.description: Required when rightsCleared is true. kind + license are always required; the gate additionally requires a traceable source (sourceUrl or sourceAsset) and a non-empty attribution.

legacyReason.description: Required when archetype is legacy-unreconciled: why these bytes ship with no rights record.
